title: Eighteen teams are expected at WR Jordyn Tyson's Friday workout

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Eighteen teams are expected at WR Jordyn Tyson's Friday workout
sources.description: Wednesday was the final day for teams to host draft prospects for visits, but workouts away from team facilities are still permitted and wide receiver Jordyn Tyson is expected to have plenty of eyes on him when he takes the field on Friday.
